opportunity: Water, sewer and solid waste enterprise funds
documented_dollar_base: FY2027 enterprise budgets $19.14M including $3.05M of indirect costs paid to the general fund; $98.5M of planned enterprise borrowing; FY2027 rate increases of 7.5% (water), 16% (sewer) and $110 to $140 (solid waste fee)
illustrative_sensitivity: Each 1% of enterprise budgets is about $0.19M per year; indirect cost allocation of $3.05M is a transfer between ratepayers and taxpayers rather than a net saving
evidence_status: Verified: budgets, rates, audited results (sewer operating loss in 8 of 10 years), declining retained earnings, and a FY2025 water appropriation deficit of $102,823 that the Finance Committee attributes to water purchased from New Bedford. questions_to_investigate: Basis for the indirect cost allocation; rate model and reserve targets; capital plan phasing and state revolving fund eligibility; collections and billing; landfill tipping fee ($25.15 per ton reported versus $110 market) and regional district assessment; cost of purchased water compared with restoring Town wells.

opportunity: Budget variance, reserves and the case for an override
documented_dollar_base: FY2025 budgetary-basis revenues exceeded the final budget by $3.81M and expenditures were $3.70M under the final budget; certified free cash has been $4.8M to $8.2M every year; unassigned general fund balance grew from $12.64M (FY2016) to $23.73M (FY2025); stabilization from $6.06M to $17.16M (FY2026)
illustrative_sensitivity: About $7.5M of combined FY2025 budget variance (derived; part of the expenditure variance may be carried forward rather than unspent)
evidence_status: Verified: audited budgetary schedules, DLS free cash and stabilization data. Hypothesis: revenue estimates are consistently conservative and recurring free cash partly offsets the described structural gap. Unavailable: the Town's multi-year forecast and revenue estimate workpapers.
questions_to_investigate: How much of annual free cash is recurring; reserve targets (no written free cash or stabilization target was located; the Reserve Fund policy is an addendum to overall financial policies that were not located); what an override would fund that recurring variance could not; publication of a five-year forecast before any override vote.
standard_note: Opportunity for further investigation. Dollar bases are documented figures; sensitivities are arithmetic illustrations and not savings estimates or findings.
